protocol.py: 2 biology problems (2 warnings).

1. WARNING MIX-TOO-WEAK: Mixing too weak to stir 8 wells: 20 × 1 ul in 25 ul
   line 63:  p20.mix(20, 1, plate[f"A{i}"])
   At line 63 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7 and A8 in slot 4 with 20
   strokes of 1 ul in a well holding 25 ul (this line did it 8 times). The well holds more
   than the p20_single_gen2 can draw, so the stroke is judged against the pipette's 20 ul.
   20 strokes of 1 ul move 1 of the pipette's 20 ul in all; it takes about 2 pipette-fulls
   of strokes to mix (the mixing work). Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three
   mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the
   concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the
   error.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7 and A8 in slot 4.
   Fix: Mix with the pipette's full volume (20 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 20, well)`, or
   use a bigger pipette.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Integra: three serial-dilution protocols (over 80% of the volume, five times)
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applications/3-simple-and-proven-automation-protocols-serial-dilutions-assist-plus-pipetting-robot
   Source: Beckman AMPure XP instructions (mix with a tip volume just below the well volume)
           https://research.fredhutch.org/content/dam/research/hahn/methods/Agencourt%20AMPure%20XP.pdf
   Source: Esca Automation: serial dilution, a classic technique
           https://escaautomation.substack.com/p/serial-dilution-a-classic-technique
   Source: labautomation.io 3654: how to mix a bacteria sample enough
           https://labautomation.io/t/how-to-mix-bacteria-sample-enough/3654
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error

The well holds more than the p20_single_gen2 can draw, so the stroke is judged against the pipette's 20 ul. 20 strokes of 1 ul move 1 of the pipette's 20 ul in all; it takes about 2 pipette-fulls of strokes to mix (the mixing work). Integra draws over 80% of the well five times; three mixes gave 11.8% CV where twenty gave 1.7%. What the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated, and in a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
findings.fix: Mix with the pipette's full volume (20 ul) at least 5 times: `mix(5, 20, well)`, or use a bigger pipette.
